Issue Title: [BUG] AWS_REGION envvar is ignored when a region is set in ~/.aws/config

Description:
### Checks

- [x] I have updated to the lastest minor and patch version of Strands
- [x] I have checked the documentation and this is not expected behavior
- [x] I have searched [./issues](./issues?q=) and there are no duplicates of my issue

### Strands Version

1.2.0

### Python Version

3.12.0

### Operating System

macOS 15.5

### Installation Method

pip

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Set region in ~/.aws/config (other than US regions)

```
[profile default]
output = json
region = ap-northeast-1
credential_process = REDACTED
```

2. Run [the strands sdk sample code](https://strandsagents.com/latest/documentation/docs/user-guide/quickstart/#project-setup) (which defaults to us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0 model) `uv run main.py` -> fails (as expected, because it tries to call US model from apac session)
```
botocore.errorfactory.ValidationException: An error occurred (ValidationException) when calling the ConverseStream operation: The provided model identifier is invalid.
└ Bedrock region: ap-northeast-1
└ Model id: us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514-v1:0
```
3. Run it with region override `AWS_REGION=us-west-2 uv run main.py`
### Expected Behavior

Step 3 successes by calling us CRI model with us-west-2 session.

### Actual Behavior

Step 3 fails. It seems we cannot override the region from environment variable.

### Additional Context

The current workaround seems using `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` environment variable instead. e.g. `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2 uv run main.py`

### Possible Solution

I think the expected behavior is that AWS_REGION environment variable is always prioritized first here.

https://github.com/strands-agents/sdk-python/blob/3d526f2e254d38bb83b8ec85af56e79e4e1fe33f/src/strands/models/bedrock.py#L138
